name: [NEW!] Mimi Tower
desc:
💃 Mimi Cucu Tower

👧 The rhythm begins! Mimi Cucu is back — dancing her way from the start all the way to the top of the tower. But don’t get too close! One wrong move and you’ll get swept away by her fabulous dance steps!

🕺 Run, hide in shelters, and find your rhythm as Mimi Cucu twirls through every level. Can you reach the end without getting hit by her moves?
👍 Like the game for more fun updates!
📢 Got feature ideas? Join our community now!
🛑 Shutdown = bug fixes or new updates.
📱 Mobile players, yes—Shift Lock works!
